title: CHANGELOG Weaver Configuration
description: Configuration schema for CHANGELOG Weaver logic including commit parsing strategies and multi-language section titles.

strategy.description: The commit parsing strategy to use.

defaultLanguage.description: Default language code for generated CHANGELOG sections (e.g., 'en', 'pt-BR', 'es').

customRegex.description: Configuration for the custom-regex strategy. Required if strategy is 'custom-regex'.

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern with capture groups to parse commit messages.

type.description: Name or index of the capture group representing the commit category/type.

scope.description: Name or index of the capture group representing the scope (optional).

description.description: Name or index of the capture group representing the commit description.

typesMap.description: Map of commit types/categories to section titles across supported languages.

additionalProperties.description: Dictionary of language codes to localized section headers.

includeScopes.description: Whether to display scopes in CHANGELOG entries.

groupUnclassified.description: Whether to group unclassified/unknown commits into an 'Other Changes' section.
